High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 Bench At Jaipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This second bail application has been filed under Section 439 of
Cr.P.C. in connection with Fir No. 48/2022 registered at Police Station Kotkasim, (Police District
Bhiwadi), District Alwar for the offences under Sections 363, 366-A and 376(2)(n) of Ipc.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that first bail application of the petitioner was dismissed
by this Court with liberty to file a fresh one after filing of the charge-sheet vide its order dated
16.09.2022.
Learned counsel further submits that the petitioner is behind the bars since 12.07.2022 and the charge-sheet has already been filed.
Learned counsel further submits that the alleged incident took place on 07.02.2022 and the FIR came to be (2 of 2) [CRLMB-16100/2022] registered on 08.02.2022.

Learned counsel further submits that the prosecutrix, after leaving her parental house,
solemnized marriage with the petitioner at Arya Samaj and started living as husband and wife.
Learned counsel further submits that a petition under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act for restitution of conjugal rights has been filed by the petitioner, which is pending.
As per rejection bail order, the petitioner has criminal antecedents of two cases, out of which, in one case he has been acquitted and in another case, he is on bail.
Hence, the accused-petitioner may be released on bail.
Learned Public Prosecutor as well as learned counsel for the complainant has strongly opposed the bail application.
Rakesh @ Rinku S/O Mahipal vs State Of Rajasthan on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172101647/
1 Heard learned counsel and perused the material available on record.

Considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the petitioner and taking into consideration overall facts and circumstances of the case but; without expressing any opinion on the merits/demerits of the case, this Court deems it just and proper to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the second bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused- petitioner Rakesh @ Rinku S/o Mahipal shall be enlarged on bail; provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the Court concerned on all the dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
(CHANDRA KUMAR SONGARA),J Ashish Kumar /22 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
